history.reason: Six tests fail only in full-suite context: each passes 3/3 (or 1/1) in isolation. SQLite threading, Windows symlink privileges and shared state under load. Pre-existing: the same set fails on the untouched main checkout. Recorded as known so a NEW failure is loud; the queued slice makes them deterministic.

Six tests are flaky, not known failures: the failing set varies run to run (5660 collected, 4-6 failing, different membership). Observed across five runs. Contention-sensitive: SQLite threading, Windows symlink privileges, shared state. The queued slice makes them deterministic; until then they are recorded as flaky so they gate in neither direction.
